# Eire Reborn - tenets. Generated by tools/gen_tenets.py
# Each tenet works as a faith tenet (new faiths and reforms) and as a personal tenet. All fifteen stay hidden until a decision unlocks them.

tenet_eir_oak_rite = {
	icon = tenet_mystical_birthright

	is_shown = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tenet_eir_oak_rite_locked_tt
			has_global_variable = eir_tenet_oak_rite
		}
	}

	can_pick = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tenet_eir_oak_rite_locked_tt
			has_global_variable = eir_tenet_oak_rite
		}
	}

	can_pick_as_personal_tenet = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tenet_eir_oak_rite_locked_tt
			has_global_variable = eir_tenet_oak_rite
		}
	}

	piety_cost = {
		value = faith_tenet_cost_mid

		# Multiplier for keeping same tenet
		if = {
			limit = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_eir_oak_rite }
			multiply = faith_unchanged_doctrine_cost_mult
		}
	}

	parameters = {
		eir_tn_oak_rite
	}

	character_modifier = {
		monthly_piety = 0.1
		lifestyle_mystic_xp_gain_mult = 0.25
		fertility = 0.05
	}

	county_modifier = {
		county_opinion_add = 2
	}

	personal_tenet_modifier = {
		monthly_piety = 0.3
		lifestyle_mystic_xp_gain_mult = 0.5
		stress_gain_mult = -0.1
	}

	personal_tenet_parameters = {
		eir_tn_oak_rite_p
	}

	traits = {
		virtues = {
			lifestyle_mystic = { weight = 15 scale = 2 }
			zealous = { weight = 10 scale = 1 }
		}
		sins = {
			cynical = { weight = 10 scale = 1 }
		}
	}
}

			honest = { weight = 10 scale = 1 }
		}
		sins = {
			fickle = { weight = 15 scale = 1 }
		}
	}
}

tenet_eir_heavy_crown = {
	icon = tenet_hedonistic

	is_shown = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tenet_eir_heavy_crown_locked_tt
			has_global_variable = eir_tenet_heavy_crown
		}
	}

	can_pick = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tenet_eir_heavy_crown_locked_tt
			has_global_variable = eir_tenet_heavy_crown
		}
	}

	can_pick_as_personal_tenet = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tenet_eir_heavy_crown_locked_tt
			has_global_variable = eir_tenet_heavy_crown
		}
	}

	piety_cost = {
		value = faith_tenet_cost_massive

		# Multiplier for keeping same tenet
		if = {
			limit = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_eir_heavy_crown }
			multiply = faith_unchanged_doctrine_cost_mult
		}
	}

	parameters = {
		eir_tn_heavy_crown
	}

	character_modifier = {
		legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.15
		vassal_opinion = -2
	}

	county_modifier = {
		county_opinion_add = 1
	}

	personal_tenet_modifier = {
		monthly_prestige = 0.6
		legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.3
		vassal_opinion = -4
		dynasty_opinion = -10
	}

	personal_tenet_parameters = {
		eir_tn_heavy_crown_p
	}

	traits = {
		virtues = {
			ambitious = { weight = 20 scale = 2 }
			arrogant = { weight = 10 scale = 1 }
		}
		sins = {
			humble = { weight = 15 scale = 1 }
			content = { weight = 15 scale = 1 }
		}
	}
}
